chapters.text: Photo of the bill, amount, tap a category, save — about 10 seconds.
Open Finance → Add expense (phone), or hold the AMS icon on your home screen and pick Add expense.
Tap Take a photo of the bill. If receipt reading is on, the amount, shop and category fill in by themselves.
Check the amount and category (tap a chip to change it).
Check Paid by, write Paid to, and tap Save expense.
